reviews.text: We have had our pool maintenance done by Stewart for years as well as a complete pool service renovation. We have been very happy with the customer service as well as the work. We love our weekly maintenance guy. He is very knowledgeable, friendly, and always communicates with us if something is off.
reviews.author: Brooke Welch

reviews.text: Stewart Pools has gone above and beyond with their pool services! Chance does an amazing job with the weekly pool cleanings and leaves my pool sparkling, bright, and most importantly safe to swim in. He is always so friendly and really takes the time to not only clean my pool but also explain everything to me. Would highly recommend Stewart Pools and their team
reviews.author: Jen N

reviews.text: Stewart Pools does a great job maintaining my pool and equipment especially my favorite technician Joe!  Joe does an outstanding job with my pool maintenance.  He takes great care every week making sure the pool is clean and balanced.  He also keeps me up to date on maintenance issues so they can be addressed before becoming a major issue.  Thank you Joe!!!!
reviews.author: K W D Digital

reviews.text:
We have used Stewart Pools for years.. Their service is amazing. Pump has a leak, time for filter change or being notified that a freeze is coming and getting an email with instructions on how to make sure settings are correct for the winter weather. Everything is taken care of and no worries about anything.
Our service person Landon is always on time, polite and a pleasure to work with.
Thanks for everything you do!!
reviews.author: Connie Wilson

reviews.text: Jacob is an excellent tech. He's friendly, good with dogs and efficient at his task. My pool looks fantastic and we are ready for summer. 😎
reviews.author: Neuel

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Stewart Pools. We worked closely with Jeff who was amazing! Jeff went above and beyond to ensure the renovation of the pool and new decking was completed in just two weeks, in time for an outdoor graduation party. Chris was also very helpful with the installation of an auto fill system. Both Jeff and Chris kept in contact with us daily to keep us informed of the progress. I would highly recommend Stewart Pools to anyone looking for a pool renovation!
reviews.author: Tyler Kruse

reviews.text:
@stewartpoolcompany is reliable, professional, and always consistent. Special thanks to my pool tech Kaleb—he does an outstanding job every time and is incredibly dependable. I’m lucky to be on his route!
#patriotroofer
reviews.author: Dean Gilliam

reviews.text:
My technician, Kaleb, is awesome. He consistently demonstrates a friendly and approachable demeanor, always smiling. Kaleb is very knowledgeable about pools and happy to answering questions i may have, providing excellent customer service. Since he started servicing my pool, I've noticed a significant improvement in the water quality. My pool is crystal clear at all times. Overall, I am extremely satisfied with the service Kaleb provides and feel fortunate to have him taking care of.
Reviewer samira younes

data.summary: Google reviews appear highly authentic with specific, varied praise from long-term customers. The low Yelp rating is an outlier based on very few reviews and is not consistent with the detailed, positive feedback elsewhere. No patterns of financial scams or ghosting are present.
fake_signals: Yelp rating anomaly (low volume, high discrepancy)
Limited negative review details available for analysis
authentic_signals: Specific technician names (Chance, Joe, Landon, Jacob)
Detailed project descriptions (maintenance, renovation, freeze prep)
Consistent positive themes across many Google reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating discrepancy between Google (4.8) and Yelp (2.6). Yelp shows only 8 reviews, suggesting a small, possibly negative sample. Google's 214 reviews are more representative and detailed.
